text: I can explain the five principles of chaos engineering and how an experiment differs from a test or from randomly breaking things.
I can limit an experiment's blast radius on traffic, scope and time, and write stop conditions that guard every bound in the hypothesis.
I can write a falsifiable steady-state hypothesis with a business-level metric, an exact fault and a numeric tolerance.
I can design a control-versus-experiment comparison and compute the user impact an experiment will cost.
I can plan a game day with a scenario, roles, stop conditions and a blameless review, and say what it tests that automation does not.
